claims.claim_text: The indexed Harold C or Perry row is linked at high confidence to the official Army record for Harold C Perry.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army name and a nonshared protected identifier agree with the row while the unusual printed middle field is preserved verbatim.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from official protected-identifier agreement; Harold C Perry is retained only as a documented search variant, not a silent correction.
claims.temporal_assessment: The records establish wartime Army identity, not a named pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: The coded Army occupation is not converted into employer evidence.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Homer L Perry row has a protected-identifier match to an Army record for a different name.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected identifier agrees, but the official Army bulk record names Melvin C Yager rather than Homer L Perry.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting official identifiers; the Army candidate is not accepted as Homer L Perry.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflict establishes no reliable identity, occupation, or pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: Box 597 review is required before resolving the identifier conflict; coded occupation data are withheld.

claims.claim_text: The indexed James B Perry row conflicts with an Army record spelling the surname Peery and a separate James B Peery index row.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected identifier is shared by separate Perry and Peery index rows, while the Army record uses Peery.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting shared identifier; neither indexed person is merged or selected as the Army record without file evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflict establishes no reliable pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: Boxes 593 and 597 must be compared. The printed Remove note is preserved without interpretation and the full identifier remains private.

claims.claim_text: Hart Perry received a Master of Arts degree from the University of Chicago in 1939.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: University class news identifies Hart Perry as a 1939 Master of Arts graduate; the photo archive independently identifies him as an alumnus and names the same spouse.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the uncommon exact name, institutional spouse cross-reference, 1918-1991 dates, and separately established wartime OSS identity.
claims.temporal_assessment: The 1939 degree is documented prewar student status; it is not an employer and is not shown to be immediately pre-OSS.
claims.match_notes: The later Budget and ITT career is excluded from pre-OSS claims. University of Chicago is classified only as student affiliation.
